note: Every QR code printed in the NCCD student books, decoded off the page. The codes are DRAWN, not embedded as images, and no book in the set carries a clickable link annotation — so neither the text layer nor page.get_links() sees them. Found by rendering each page and running OpenCV's detector.
howFound: scripts render each page at 150, 200 and 260 dpi and take the union. One scale is not enough and the failure is silent: only 44 of these 186 decode at 150 dpi, and the Grade 10 history S1 code on page 12 decodes at 200 while failing at 150, 300 AND 400. A single-dpi pass under-counted this set by 4x.
printedUrlIsBroken: Every ministry code prints https://qr.nccd.gov.jo/… and that host's certificate has EXPIRED (SEC_E_CERT_EXPIRED), so the URL as printed fails. The same path over http:// serves the file; that is workingUrl. An https page cannot embed an http video, so these are open-in-a-tab links, not slides that play.
kbLessonId: Present only for books whose lesson openers `outline()` can read — history and geography. A code is located by PAGE, and in Islamic/Arabic/social there is no page→lesson mapping to join through; those entries carry the page alone.
